{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data with proper parsing
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop refunded orders as they do not represent actual revenue
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] != 'refunded']

# Check conversion rate by channel, now excluding refunds
conversion_by_channel_clean = sales_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("Conversion rate by channel (excluding refunds):\n", conversion_by_channel_clean)

# Check revenue by channel, excluding refunds
revenue_by_channel_clean = sales_df.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum()
print("Revenue by channel (excluding refunds):\n", revenue_by_channel_clean)

# Check customer segment distribution by channel
segment_channel_clean = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment'])
print("Customer segment by channel (excluding refunds):\n", segment_channel_clean)

# Check if the groups are comparable
print("\nGroup comparison: email vs paid_search")
print("- Email has more loyal customers (141 vs 29)\n- Email has fewer new customers (72 vs 341)\n- Email has more returning customers (146 vs 171, but close)\n- Email has higher conversion rate (0.38 vs 0.30)\n- Email has higher revenue (4.0M vs 2.0M)\n")

# Return key results
(conversion_by_channel_clean, revenue_by_channel_clean, segment_channel_clean)"}
